prompt: The inventor of the first true pinhole camera was also the first to correctly explain what theory?
answer: Ibn al-Haytham (Alhazen) was credited with inventing the first true pinhole camera and was also the first to correctly explain the **theory of vision**—that light reflected from objects enters the eye and produces sight.
